title: SLOPE: Optimistic Potential Landscape Shaping for Model-based Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2602.03201v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) is sample-efficient but struggles in sparse reward settings. A critical bottleneck arises from the lack of informative gradients in sparse settings, where standard reward models often yield flat landscapes that struggle to guide planning. To address this challenge, we propose Shaping Landscapes with Optimistic Potential Estimates (SLOPE), a novel framework that shifts reward modeling from predicting sparse scalars to constructing informative potential landscapes. SLOPE employs optimistic distributional regression to estimate high-confidence upper bounds, which amplifies rare success signals and ensures sufficient exploration gradients. Evaluations on 30+ tasks across 5 benchmarks and real-world robotic deployments, demonstrate that SLOPE consistently outperforms leading baselines in fully sparse, semi-sparse, and dense rewards. The project code is available at https://github.com/Arya87/SLOPE.

translated_title: SLOPE：面向基于模型的强化学习的乐观势能景观塑形方法
translated_abstract: 基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）具有样本高效的优点，但在稀疏奖励环境中表现不佳。其关键瓶颈在于稀疏环境下缺乏信息丰富的梯度，标准奖励模型往往产生平坦的势能景观，难以引导规划。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了基于乐观势能估计的景观塑形方法（SLOPE），这是一个新颖的框架，将奖励建模从预测稀疏标量转变为构建信息丰富的势能景观。SLOPE采用乐观分布回归来估计高置信度上界，从而放大罕见的成功信号并确保充分的探索梯度。在5个基准测试的30多个任务以及真实世界机器人部署上的评估表明，SLOPE在全稀疏、半稀疏和稠密奖励设置中始终优于领先的基线方法。项目代码可在 https://github.com/Arya87/SLOPE 获取。
tldr: SLOPE通过乐观分布回归估计高置信度上界来构建信息丰富的势能景观，放大稀疏奖励中的罕见成功信号，从而显著提升基于模型的强化学习在稀疏奖励任务上的性能。
en_tdlr: SLOPE shapes informative potential landscapes via optimistic distributional regression, amplifying rare success signals to enable model-based reinforcement learning to excel in sparse reward settings.
